summary_en: This study tests intravesical recombinant Mycobacterium BCG (rMBCG), a drug placed into the bladder, in adults with non-muscle invasive bladder cancer who have not had BCG before. It is given as one vial (19.2e8 colony-forming units) through a urinary catheter into the bladder as an induction course; the number of doses and how often are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; the study is a Phase 1/2 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba el Mycobacterium BCG recombinante intravesical (rMBCG), un medicamento que se coloca en la vejiga, en adultos con cáncer de vejiga no músculo invasivo que nunca han recibido BCG. Se administra como un vial (19.2e8 unidades formadoras de colonias) por una sonda urinaria dentro de la vejiga, como curso de inducción; el número de dosis y la frecuencia no se indican. La medida principal de resultado no se indica; el estudio es de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Bladder cancer that has never been treated with BCG.
Carcinoma in situ, or stage Ta and/or T1 papillary tumors after transurethral resection.
No resectable disease left after TURBT surgery; residual carcinoma in situ is allowed.
not_for: Muscle-invasive, locally advanced, metastatic, or extravesical bladder cancer.
Other cancer in the past 5 years that is progressing or needs active treatment, with listed exceptions.
Heart failure NYHA class III or IV, unstable angina, or heart attack within 6 months.
Active systemic infection needing IV antibiotics, active urinary tract infection, or active tuberculosis.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or lab values outside the study limits (low neutrophils or platelets, high liver enzymes or creatinine).
